source.title: Stomping Out The Infestation
source.description: Disgusting. This place has become infested with rotting nerubian drones. I would see them destroyed.
source.objective: Slay 5 Crypt Walkers and 8 Crypt Fiends then return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered at his former home in Terrordale.
source.completion: It's more than likely a meaningless gesture, but I feel at least a tiny bit better.
